name: modulating-cadence-declined-reveal-still-puts-the-rest-on-the-bottom
notes: Modulating Cadence: look at the top eight cards, decline to reveal the Melody among them. The eight cards must still go to the bottom of the deck; declining used to skip ModulatingCadenceReveal, so they were never rearranged and stayed in the temp zone.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Modulating Cadence's optional-choice continuation (ModulatingCadenceReveal) handles the declined choice itself, but Core's ExecuteStaticMethods() skipped it on PASS (it was queued by a generated card body without dontSkipOnPass): the looked-at cards were never put on the bottom of the deck after the reveal was declined. Fix: Grand Archive registers the handler as decline-aware (GameCustomHandlerRunsOnPass, asked by Core before it skips) and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
